answers.notes: R is false: the boycott explicitly targeted government schools, colleges and courts; the stated reason for limited impact is lack of ready Indian institutions.

prose_issues.problem: NCERT says Bengali has no letter for Sanskrit va (only ba). The Bengali text says Bengali lacks "ভ", which is false (ভ exists), and writes the Sanskrit form identically to the Bengali one. A student would learn a false fact about the alphabet. Should say: Sanskrit "বন্দে" (va); Bengali has only ব (ba).

NCERT does not call Swadeshi the first big mass protest; Our Pasts III calls the Rowlatt Satyagraha the first all-India struggle (cities only), and Class VIII describes earlier movements (Kuka, Birsa). Also "পরবর্তী আন্দোলনের পথ দেখায়" is not stated for Swadeshi.
prose_issues.quote: The Rowlatt Satyagraha turned out to be the first all-India struggle against the British government

prose_issues.problem: NCERT: the Alipore trial went on for a year before Aurobindo was acquitted. The line files the acquittal under 1908; NCERT gives no acquittal year, and the trial ran roughly 1908-09.
prose_issues.quote: went on for a year ... In the end, Aurobindo was acquitted

prose_issues.text: বাংলার বিপ্লবী ধারার প্রথম বড় ঘটনা
prose_issues.problem: NCERT does not call the Kingsford attempt the first big event; it mentions the Anushilan Samiti (1902) and, in western India, the Chapekar killings (1897).
prose_issues.quote: the Anushilan Samiti was set up in 1902 ... three Chapekar brothers shot dead the British Plague Commissioner of Poona

prose_issues.text: তিন প্রদেশ বহুদূরে বলে এঁদের একসঙ্গে "লাল-বাল-পাল" বলা হত
prose_issues.problem: NCERT (Class XII): the alliteration "Lal, Bal and Pal" conveyed the all-India character since their provinces were far apart. The Bengali reads as if distance is the reason they were named together.
prose_issues.quote: the alliteration conveying the all-India character of their struggle, since their native provinces were very distant from one another

prose_issues.text: ঢাকা ছিল সেই নতুন প্রদেশের সম্ভাব্য রাজধানী, যার কথা বন্দে মাতরম পত্রিকা লিখেছিল
prose_issues.problem: Stated as fact. NCERT only reproduces the Bande Mataram article, which says the government was said to want a "Mahomedan province" with Dacca as capital. NCERT does not confirm Dhaka as the planned capital.
prose_issues.quote: to create a Mahomedan province with Dacca as its capital

prose_issues.text: এনসিইআরটি-র ভাষায় "ক্ষতি ততদিনে হয়ে গিয়েছিল" (linked to separate electorates and the League)
prose_issues.problem: The paragraph first says NCERT does not explain the damage, then ties the quote to separate electorates and the League. NCERT does not specify the damage.
prose_issues.quote: But the damage had been done.

prose_issues.text: বঙ্গভঙ্গ থেকে মুসলিম লীগ ও পৃথক নির্বাচকমণ্ডলী (cause: বঙ্গভঙ্গের পর বেশিরভাগ মুসলিম নেতার সমর্থন)
prose_issues.problem: Title and causes present the partition (and Muslim leaders' support for it) as a cause of the League. NCERT says the League was founded "in the aftermath of the Swadeshi Movement" and that Muslim concerns began with the Congress's formation.
prose_issues.quote: In the aftermath of the Swadeshi Movement ... Their concerns had been growing since the formation of the Congress

prose_issues.text: এনসিইআরটি-র মতে আসল উদ্দেশ্য ছিল "বিভাজন ও শাসন" ... বাঙালি রাজনীতিকদের প্রভাব কমানো
prose_issues.problem: Our Pasts III hedges: "Perhaps the main British motives". The quick summary states it as settled. (New Class VIII is firmer on divide and rule.)
prose_issues.quote: Perhaps the main British motives were to curtail the influence of Bengali politicians and to split the Bengali people.

prose_issues.problem: NCERT uses the label Extremist/Radical for the group in the first decade of the 20th century (by Moderates and British); the 1890s leaders are described as exploring "more radical objectives". Minor label/date slippage.
prose_issues.quote: In the first decade of the 20th century, the Moderates and the British authorities labelled those who called for nothing less than India's independence

prose_issues.text: সরকার তার দাবি গুরুত্ব দেয়নি, তাই ১৮৯০-এর দশক থেকে ... নেতারা আত্মনির্ভরতা ও স্বরাজের কথা বলতে শুরু করেন
prose_issues.problem: NCERT notes the government ignoring Congress and, separately, that by the 1890s many questioned the Congress style. It does not state the first caused the second.
prose_issues.quote: By the 1890s, many Indians began to raise questions about the political style of the Congress.

prose_issues.text: রবীন্দ্রনাথ ... ছড়া, পাঁচালি ও গল্প সংগ্রহ
prose_issues.problem: NCERT: "ballads, nursery rhymes and myths". Panchali (a narrative verse form) and "গল্প" (stories) differ from ballads (গাথা) and myths (পুরাণকথা).

prose_issues.text: বাংলার রাজনীতিকে সর্বভারতীয় রাজনীতির কেন্দ্রে নিয়ে আসে
prose_issues.problem: Not in NCERT. NCERT says the partition infuriated people all over India and protests spread beyond Bengal; it does not claim Bengal politics moved to the centre of national politics.
prose_issues.quote: The partition of Bengal infuriated people all over India.
